card.name: Numbers in size measurements
card.fires_on: Digits and decimal points inside a metric size figure, usually the first number (width) of a height-by-width pair, converted from inches. Seen in artwork dimensions and product sizes.

modes.label: Artwork dimensions
modes.description: Decimal centimeter values for sheet, plate or canvas size after the inch measurements.
modes.example: brown and flesh on paper. Sheet: 18 13/16 x 14 3/8 in.; 47<<.>>7838 x 36

modes.label: Product or patch size
modes.description: Metric conversion in parentheses after inch sizes of an item.
